task: open-tennis-robots: fit the wheel drop on tach edge times (flagship buildable item)

deviations.why: No llms.txt or marketing page change: the work is a firmware estimator option that is off by default, nothing user-facing changed.

goal: Test whether fitting the loop-command drop on tach edge times (running sums) beats the period fit under tach jitter.
notes: Edge-time fit added as controller.drop_from_commands_steps(edges=True), off by default (LOOP_FIT_EDGES False). Refuted on the simulator: single wheels (tests/edge_fit_sweep.py, 24 cases x 6 seeds) remove wild readings at 10-20 us jitter (worst 63% -> 5% at 10 us) but p90 grows at 2-10 us; whole calibration drill (tests/edge_fit_drill.py, 54 drills) spin rms 2.20 -> 2.92 at 5 us, 6.55 -> 9.02 at 10 us, 8.67 -> 9.77 at 80 ms ESC lag. Linear toy: gain for a step only 4%. Default path unchanged (loop_residual_sweep numbers reproduce exactly). Verification: test_host LoopDropTest/LoopFitUnsureTest/PulseDropTest/PeriodTachTest pass; run_venture_tests.py open-tennis-robots output in PR.
